title: EC2 Instance Failure – Status Check and Recovery
description: EC2 recovery with pre-checks. Reads instance classification guide from S3 to decide between soft reboot vs hard stop-start vs replacement.

decision_tree.name: Classify status check failure
decision_tree.instruction: Read EC2 status check type. System status check failure means AWS hardware issue. Instance status check failure means OS/app issue.

conditions.note: AWS hardware issue – stop/start moves to new host
Both failed – hard reset, confirm before action
Cannot determine failure – human check needed

decision_tree.name: Check if instance is in Auto Scaling Group
decision_tree.instruction: If instance is in an ASG, terminating it is safer than rebooting – ASG will replace it. If standalone, reboot carefully.

conditions.note: Let ASG health check terminate and replace

decision_tree.name: Verify instance recovery
decision_tree.instruction: After reboot/stop-start, verify both status checks pass within 5 minutes and application responds.

conditions.note: Instance up but app not responding – app-level issue
Instance still unhealthy – may need replacement from AMI

feedback_notes: System status failures need stop-start (new host). Instance status failures only need reboot.
